title: Card Deposit Fee on the Paloma Business Balance
content:
**Fee clause.** The card deposit fee of a Paloma Business account is worked out for the most recent debit-card deposit on the account's ledger. The card deposit rate is the plan's card deposit fee percentage, and the card deposit fee is the whole deposit times that rate over 100, never below 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent.

### Restated

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Deposit the fee is worked out for | The most recent debit-card deposit on the ledger |
| Amount the rate is charged on | The whole deposit |
| Card deposit rate | The plan's card deposit fee percentage |
| Rounding | Half up to the cent |
| Floor | 0.00 |

### Worked figures (hypothetical deposits)

1. Paloma Business Growth, card deposit fee percentage 2.50: a debit-card deposit of 4000.00 USD multiplied by 2.50 over 100 gives a card deposit fee of 100.00 USD.
2. Paloma Business Starter, 2.90: a deposit of 1234.56 USD gives 35.80224, rounded half up to 35.80 USD.
3. An account with two debit-card deposits, 3000.00 USD on 2 May and 1500.00 USD on 9 May: the fee is worked out for the 9 May deposit, the most recent.
